title: Algerian Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African stew made with chicken, onions, and spices, cooked to perfection in a clay pot.
instructions: Heat oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the Algerian spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the roasted red pepper and yellow bell pepper, and stir to combine.
Add 1 cup of water to the tagine and bring to a simmer.
Cover the tagine and cook over low heat for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
